text: dsh-web-search-yuanbao 是接入 DSH Web 能力的腾讯 Yuanbao 搜索提供方。它向 ctx.web 注册 yuanbao 搜索后端，每次搜索直接请求腾讯 Search API，并将可用结果整理为标题、网址、摘要和标准化发布日期。用户可以按请求上限选择结果数，缺少摘要或网址的结果会被舍弃。适合需要通过 Yuanbao 搜索网页并在 DSH 中使用来源信息的场景。需要腾讯云 WSA API Key，可通过凭据服务或 TENCENTCLOUD_WSA_APIKEY 提供；查询内容会发送到 api.wsa.cloud.tencent.com。

dsh-web-search-yuanbao adds Tencent Yuanbao Search to DSH web search. It sends each query to Tencent and maps usable results to URLs, excerpts, titles, and normalized dates. A Tencent Cloud WSA API key is required through credentials or TENCENTCLOUD_WSA_APIKEY.

dsh-web-search-yuanbao 的功能「Yuanbao 网页搜索」：将查询提交给腾讯搜索 API，并把可用结果整理为网址、摘要、标题和标准化发布日期。
dsh-web-search-yuanbao 的功能「搜索结果数适配」：搜索请求可提供结果数上限；提供方将其向上适配到腾讯 API 支持的 10、20、30、40 或 50 条，并在返回后整理可用页面。
dsh-web-search-yuanbao 使用前须知：每次搜索会把查询词和结果数发送到 api.wsa.cloud.tencent.com 的 SearchPro 接口。

dsh-web-search-yuanbao README · Summary：With `dsh-web-search-yuanbao`, the harness searches the web through Tencent Yuanbao Search and gets titles, URLs, excerpts, and publication dates from one direct API request. Choose it when a deployment holds a Tencent Cloud WSA API key and wants Yuanbao's search index without an auxiliary model turn. The provider maps `passage` (or a vertical result's `content`) to `snippet`, normalizes the service's date format to ISO-8601, and drops entries without a URL or excerpt. The model-facing `web_search` tool lives in `dsh-tool-web`.

dsh-web-search-yuanbao README · Use this package：Mount the provider in a composition that already loads the web service; it registers as the `yuanbao` search provider, so `ctx.web.search()` resolves it automatically when it is the only usable search backend — or pin it with `searchProvider: yuanbao`.

dsh-web-search-yuanbao README · Install into a profile：The package declares a `dsh.bundle` layer, so `dsh plugin` installs it and adds the provider row for you:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile demo add ./dsh-web-search-yuanbao
```

The layer inserts the provider beside the base `web` row. Select it by setting `searchProvider: yuanbao` on that row in the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` (or leave it as the only usable search backend). Store the key through the credentials service, or export `TENCENTCLOUD_WSA_APIKEY` in the launch environment.

dsh-web-search-yuanbao README · When to choose it：Choose this backend when a deployment has a Tencent Cloud Yuanbao Search API key and wants one direct retrieval request per query. Unlike `dsh-web-search-deepseek`, no model turn runs for a search, so latency and cost scale with the retrieval API alone. The provider is unavailable when the endpoint base does not parse; the configuration schema rejects any count other than 10, 20, 30, 40, or 50. A missing credential is reported when the search runs.

dsh-web-search-yuanbao README · Minimal configuration：Load the web service and the provider; the API key resolves through `ctx.credentials` when that service is mounted, otherwise from `$TENCENTCLOUD_WSA_APIKEY` in the launch environment.

```yaml
- name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-web'
- name: 'dsh-web-search-yuanbao'
  config:
    apiKeyEnv: TENCENTCLOUD_WSA_APIKEY

dsh-web-search-yuanbao README · Minimal configuration：| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | omitted | Literal API key; prefer `apiKeyEnv` so no secret enters configuration |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `TENCENTCLOUD_WSA_APIKEY` | Credential reference resolved for each search; a non-empty literal `apiKey` wins |
| `baseURL` | `https://api.wsa.cloud.tencent.com` | Endpoint base; `/SearchPro` is appended. An unparseable value makes the provider unavailable |
| `count` | `10` | Results per search when the request carries no bound; one of 10, 20, 30, 40, 50. An unsupported value makes the provider unavailable |

dsh-web-search-yuanbao README · Minimal configuration：The generated [configuration catalog](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/config-catalog.md#deepseek-aidsh-web-search-yuanbao) is the exhaustive source for every accepted field and its JSDoc.

dsh-web-search-yuanbao README · What a search returns：Each usable page maps to a `WebSearchSource`: `url`, `title` when present, `snippet` from `passage` (a vertical result falls back to `content`), and `publishedAt` normalized to ISO-8601. A vertical result prefers the URL, title, and date in its `display` envelope. An entry without a URL or excerpt is dropped; the service returns no generated answer, so `content` is omitted. A request's `maxResults` is rounded up to the smallest accepted `Cnt` — a bound of 8 sends 10 — and the web service enforces the final bound by truncating and flagging.

dsh-web-search-yuanbao README · Failures and recovery：Provider failures — HTTP errors, network failures, unparseable or wrongly structured bodies, and an error envelope — surface as `WebError` `WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR`; an aborted request surfaces as `WEB_ABORTED`; a missing key surfaces as `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING`. HTTP redirects are rejected before the `Location` target is contacted. The provider does not retry or fall back to another backend. Callers route on the code; the model-facing `web_search` tool surfaces failures to the model under its own error wrapper.

dsh-web-search-yuanbao README · Development：This project is a standalone extraction of the `web-search-yuanbao` package from the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) monorepo. It supports the published `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` packages from `0.2.1-rc.2` through `0.2.1-rc.5`, so no monorepo checkout is required; the development dependencies are aligned at `0.2.1-rc.5`.

Requires Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` and pnpm.

<summary>Implementation internals — click to expand</summary>

This section explains the design decisions behind the provider; the observable behavior is fully covered in [Use this package](#use-this-package).
dsh-web-search-yuanbao README · Design philosophy：The provider is a thin adapter over Yuanbao's Search API with three deliberate rules:

dsh-web-search-yuanbao README · Design philosophy：- **Direct retrieval only.** One request per search; no auxiliary model request, unlike the Messages-backed DeepSeek provider.
- **Portable excerpts only.** A source needs a real URL and excerpt; deriving one from other fields would make the seam lie, so unusable entries are dropped.
- **Per-search credentials.** The stored key is read for each operation, so a stored or rotated key reaches the next search without a restart.

dsh-web-search-yuanbao README · Source map：| File | Role |
|---|---|
| [`src/index.ts`](src/index.ts) | Plugin entry: config schema, credential and environment resolution, provider registration |
| [`src/provider.ts`](src/provider.ts) | The `YuanbaoSearchProvider`: request dispatch, response decoding, result mapping, abort classification |
| [`src/types.ts`](src/types.ts) | Yuanbao wire types: `YuanbaoSearchResponse`, `YuanbaoPage`, `YuanbaoError` |

dsh-web-search-yuanbao README · Request and mapping flow：`search()` reads one settings snapshot, resolves the credential, and posts `{ Query, Cnt }` to `{baseURL}/SearchPro` with `redirect: 'error'`, so a redirect fails without contacting the target. Each `Response.Pages` entry is decoded from its JSON string; usable pages are mapped in order and unusable ones dropped. An error envelope becomes `WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR`, as does any body the provider cannot interpret. An abort — a `DOMException` named `AbortError` — becomes `WEB_ABORTED`.

</details>

dsh-web-search-yuanbao README · Model Experience：Indirectly, through `dsh-tool-web`, which retains this provider's `maxResults`-bounded URLs, titles, excerpts, and ISO-8601 dates or its exact `Yuanbao search aborted`, `Yuanbao search request failed: <error>`, `Yuanbao search credential resolution failed: <error>`, `Yuanbao returned an invalid response body`, `Yuanbao search has no API key for "<ref>"`, and provider error-envelope messages under the consumer's error wrapper.
dsh-web-search-yuanbao README · KV Cache effect：No direct invalidation; the named consumer owns any request-prefix changes.
dsh-web-search-yuanbao README · Known Limitations and Deferred Work： These limits define when the provider is a poor fit. They are current package constraints.

dsh-web-search-yuanbao README · Known Limitations and Deferred Work：- **Only the query and result count reach the service** — the seam request has no site, mode, industry, or freshness field, so the skill's other controls wait on provider-neutral service fields.
- **An entry without a URL or excerpt is dropped entirely** — fewer sources than requested can return.
- **Dynamic credential availability resolves inside the operation** — the synchronous availability check cannot query the credential store, so a selected keyless provider fails the search with `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING`.
- **An unrecognized date is omitted** — `publishedAt` must be ISO-8601, so a provider value that neither matches ISO nor `YYYY/MM/DD HH:mm:ss` is dropped rather than passed through.
